substantive_reviews.title: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
substantive_reviews.affiliation: First author Weichen Yu: Google Cloud AI Research / Carnegie Mellon University, verified from v1 PDF page1 superscripts1,2; Google DeepMind collaboration separately confirmed
substantive_reviews.method: 用 MOEA/D 加权 Tchebycheff 子问题保留功能/安全权衡；工具、技能、逻辑按通用/环境范围分解演化，执行时动态组合。候选只用搜索集选最均衡子代，held-out 不参与选择。
substantive_reviews.code_status: 未在所读论文/官方摘要中找到作者实现仓库；有匿名结果可视化，不等于开源算法代码
substantive_reviews.low_cost_component_opportunity: 可独立验证 Tchebycheff 邻域替换与上限、范围受限算子计划、搜索集选优和冻结 held-out 的数据合同；不是完整自进化 agent
substantive_reviews.full_experiment_disposition: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）
substantive_reviews.cost_basis: 正文 §5 采用 Gemini 3.6 Flash proposer/solver；SecRepoBench 30/30/30 和 BaxBench 28/28/28，三次独立运行；Appendix G 展示5子问题×3代/6子问题×4代；Appendix I 明确 Docker build/exploit 主导耗时。费用为依据论文规模的估计，未启动实跑。
evidence_locations: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15150v1#page=1: first author superscripts1,2 and Student Researcher footnote
substantive_reviews.read_scope: Named method, evaluation, implementation and cost passages; not every appendix proof or prompt.
